test_CacheState_exists: test the CacheState class to check if a cache entry exists for a dataset config or split
test_CacheState_is_success: test the CacheState class to verify if a cache entry has a successful HTTP status
test_ArtifactState: test the ArtifactState class to inspect cache and job state for a processing step
test_SplitState: test the SplitState class to inspect artifact states by step for a dataset split
test_DatasetState: test the DatasetState class to inspect config states and artifact states for a full dataset
